name: large-text-overflow
prompt: At 200% text scale, the checkout button disappears on a narrow phone. Fix it and verify the flow remains accessible.

name: flaky-widget-test
prompt: A widget test hangs because an animation never settles. Remove the flakiness without launching an emulator.

name: android-deep-link-runtime
prompt: Confirm on an Android emulator that a protected product deep link opens the correct screen and preserves back behavior.

name: ephemeral-toggle
prompt: An app already uses Riverpod. Move a password visibility toggle to the right owner without changing the overall architecture.

name: visual-polish-dashboard
prompt: Redesign this bland Flutter analytics dashboard with clear hierarchy, coherent typography, color and surfaces, plus professional loading, empty, and error states while preserving its state management.

name: offline-api-cache
prompt: Add offline task browsing backed by a paginated API and a local database, preserving the existing HTTP and database packages.

name: local-database-schema-migration
prompt: Migrate the existing Flutter SQLite database from schema version 3 or 4 to version 5 while preserving user-authored notes and pending outbox operations. Keep the current database package and test rollback, reopen, and direct skipped-version upgrades.

name: remote-api-schema-change-is-not-local-migration
prompt: Update the generated Flutter client for a documented OpenAPI response-field rename and verify runtime decoding. This feature has no local database, durable queue, or on-device cache.

name: signed-bundle-no-upload
prompt: Produce and smoke-test a signed staging Android App Bundle, but do not upload or publish it.

name: stale-search-result
prompt: Search results sometimes show an older HTTP response after the newest query finishes. Fix the ordering bug.

name: cohesive-screen-refactor
prompt: Split a 500-line checkout screen into maintainable widgets without changing state management or app architecture.

name: complete-feature-delivery
prompt: Build an offline-capable checkout feature across UI, state, API, persistence, tests, and Android device verification.

name: localized-rtl-layout
prompt: Localize a price summary for Arabic and fix its RTL overflow with large text.

name: hardcoded-production-secret
prompt: Audit and fix a production service credential hardcoded in lib/api_config.dart; no native code is involved, and do not rotate or revoke anything yet.

name: review-working-tree-without-fixes
prompt: Review the current Flutter working-tree diff for actionable bugs and risks, but do not edit files.

name: review-widget-test-diff-without-rewriting-tests
prompt: Review only the changed Flutter widget tests for false positives, weak assertions, async flakiness, and missing regression coverage. Report findings without editing the tests or application code.

name: broad-flutter-threat-audit-is-not-generic-code-review
prompt: Perform a repository-wide Flutter threat audit covering credentials, local storage, WebViews, deep links, platform channels, and production data exposure. This is not a pull-request or diff review.

name: focused-async-fix-does-not-preload-review-skill
prompt: Fix a stale search-result race in one existing Bloc and add the focused regression test. Preserve the current architecture; I am asking for implementation, not a separate code review.

name: isolated-widget-previews
prompt: Add deterministic Widget Previewer variants for our payment card in loading, error, light, dark, and large-text states.

name: cross-platform-c-library
prompt: Expose an existing C image-processing library to Flutter on Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and Linux using the current supported native binding workflow.

name: offline-mutation-conflicts
prompt: Implement queued offline task edits and deletions with retries, conflict handling, and safe reconciliation after reconnect.

name: validated-profile-form
prompt: Build a profile form over our existing profile service with focus traversal, local and remote validation, duplicate-submit protection, and recoverable server errors. Do not change the HTTP client or redesign the screen.

name: ios-liquid-glass-tool-palette
prompt: Translate an iOS 26 Liquid Glass floating tool palette into Flutter for iOS, Android, and web, including backdrop refraction, grouped glass shapes, interactive edge light, a collapsed-to-expanded morph, and opaque or low-cost fallbacks where the renderer or accessibility settings require them.

name: notification-delivery-lifecycle
prompt: Implement recurring local reminders plus remote push handling across permission, token refresh, foreground, background, terminated taps, duplicate payloads, and time-zone changes while preserving our existing packages.

name: flutter-production-observability
prompt: Instrument our existing Flutter production stack with privacy-safe structured logs, framework and isolate error capture, traces, release context, symbols, and end-to-end ingestion verification.

name: flutter-ci-quality-gates
prompt: Harden our existing GitLab CI pipeline with deterministic Flutter format, analyze, generation, tests, cache, signed staging artifacts, protected secrets, and no publication yet.

name: graphql-live-feed
prompt: Extend our existing GraphQL client with a cursor-paginated feed, normalized cache updates, partial-data handling, and a live subscription that resyncs after reconnect.

name: duplicate-websocket-listeners
prompt: Navigating between two Flutter screens leaves duplicate WebSocket subscriptions alive, so stale callbacks update disposed state even though the transport itself connects correctly.

name: dart-three-domain-result-model
prompt: Our Dart SDK constraint supports Dart 3. Refactor a parser result API from loosely typed maps into an exhaustive sealed success/failure model with pattern matching, without changing app architecture or adding asynchronous work.

name: interruptible-reduced-motion-transition
prompt: Implement an interruptible staggered card transition in Flutter that reverses cleanly and becomes an immediate state change when reduced motion is requested.

name: incremental-feature-architecture-migration
prompt: Evolve one legacy Flutter feature whose widgets call SQLite directly into clear UI, repository, and service boundaries. Preserve the app's existing Bloc conventions and avoid a whole-repository rewrite.

name: profile-mode-product-grid-jank
prompt: A Flutter product grid repeatedly drops frames during fast scrolling on a mid-range Android device. Profile and attribute the bottleneck, make the smallest justified fix, and report comparable before and after evidence.

name: figma-checkout-node-to-flutter
prompt: Implement the supplied Figma checkout node in our Flutter app using its existing theme and shared payment components, then verify visual parity at the reference phone size and the specified tablet breakpoint.

name: terminated-periodic-catalog-sync
prompt: Schedule a deferrable catalog sync that should survive ordinary Flutter process death and Android reboot, runs only with network access, and safely tolerates duplicate delivery. Preserve the scheduler package already in the app.

name: in-process-image-compression-isolate
prompt: Compress a large image without blocking frames while the export screen remains open. The work may be cancelled when the screen and app process close.

name: custom-native-background-scheduler-bridge
prompt: Our supported Flutter packages cannot expose a required native background scheduler API. Build a typed Dart-to-native bridge while preserving OS scheduling limits, expiration, retry, and device lifecycle verification.

name: resolve-transitive-pub-conflict
prompt: Resolve a Pub solver conflict where two direct Flutter dependencies require incompatible versions of the same transitive package. Preserve the committed application lockfile policy and do not use a permanent dependency override.

name: upgrade-flutter-sdk-and-ci-pin
prompt: Upgrade this Flutter app to the requested stable SDK, migrate its compatible package and Android/iOS toolchain requirements, and update the existing GitHub Actions Flutter pin without publishing artifacts.

name: rtl-localized-checkout-on-narrow-phone
prompt: Localize the checkout screen for Arabic with correct RTL layout, currency formatting, and ensure all actions remain reachable at 200% text scale on a 320dp-wide phone.

name: ticker-leak-in-route-transition-test
prompt: A widget test fails because an AnimationController from a route transition animation leaks its ticker after the test disposes the widget. Fix the leak and verify the animation still works without launching a device.

name: major-sdk-bump-with-signing-and-artifact-verification
prompt: Upgrade the Flutter SDK to the next major stable, re-sign the staging Android artifact with the existing keystore, and verify the build installs and launches on a connected device. Do not upload to any store.

name: reusable-federated-plugin-release
prompt: Evolve our publicly consumed Flutter plugin with an independently maintained Linux implementation, a compatible platform interface, an example app, and pub.dev readiness checks without publishing it.

name: app-owned-native-bridge-not-package
prompt: Add a small typed Android and iOS bridge used only by this Flutter app for a product-specific scanner API; it will not be distributed as a package.

name: attach-to-running-lifecycle-failure
prompt: A running Flutter add-to-app screen becomes stuck only after the host app backgrounds and resumes. Attach without destroying the failing state, identify the first incorrect lifecycle transition, fix it, and repeat the same flow.

name: planned-device-smoke-test-not-debugging
prompt: Run the already passing checkout acceptance flow on the specified Android emulator and record whether rotation and process recreation preserve the cart.

name: android-emulator-lifecycle-operation
prompt: Boot the existing staging Android emulator without wiping it, install and launch the current Flutter build, exercise background and resume, capture a screenshot and focused logs, then restore task-created device overrides.

name: native-permission-dialog-device-flow
prompt: Run the Flutter checkout acceptance flow on an iOS Simulator, interact with the native camera permission dialog using the project's existing automation stack, and verify the Flutter-owned denied and granted states.

name: provider-neutral-streaming-model-chat
prompt: Add streamed AI assistant responses to this Flutter app through its existing backend and provider, handle cancellation and tool confirmation, and do not change its state-management package.

name: human-support-chat-is-not-ai
prompt: Build realtime text chat between customers and human support agents over the existing WebSocket API, including reconnect and missed-message recovery. No model generates or interprets messages.

name: verified-store-subscription-entitlement
prompt: Add App Store and Play subscriptions to the existing Flutter app, verify transactions with its backend, restore access after reinstall, and handle pending, grace, expiration, and account switching without changing the billing provider.

name: physical-goods-checkout-is-not-iap
prompt: Build a card checkout form for physical grocery delivery through the existing payment processor API. No digital content or app-store product is sold.

name: oauth-pkce-session-lifecycle
prompt: Implement provider-neutral OAuth login for Flutter mobile and web with PKCE, verified redirects, coordinated refresh, logout, and safe account switching while preserving the current router and HTTP client.

name: authentication-threat-review-stays-security-led
prompt: Audit this Flutter repository for concrete authentication vulnerabilities involving token storage, redirect interception, authorization enforcement, and logout cleanup. Report findings only; do not implement a new login flow.

name: existing-session-authenticated-http-transport
prompt: The existing login flow and session owner already expose access and refresh tokens. Update the current Dio interceptor to attach the access token, coordinate one refresh after concurrent 401 responses, retry only safe requests, and map terminal unauthorized failures without changing the identity provider, login UI, token storage, or account lifecycle.

name: consent-aware-product-funnel
prompt: Instrument the signup-to-purchase product funnel with stable events, anonymous-to-account identity rules, consent handling, duplicate prevention, and staging backend verification while preserving the current analytics provider.

name: production-crash-context-is-not-product-analytics
prompt: Add release-correlated crash capture and operational breadcrumbs for a production Flutter checkout failure without collecting payment or customer data.

name: embedded-first-party-web-checkout-bridge
prompt: Our Flutter app already depends on a WebView plugin. Implement an embedded first-party checkout page with that dependency, a strict origin policy, a typed JavaScript completion bridge, cookie-aware logout, external-link handoff, and Android/iOS device verification. The plugin itself is not being changed or distributed.

name: oauth-external-user-agent-is-not-webview
prompt: Add OAuth sign-in with authorization code PKCE, state, verified redirects, refresh, and logout to this Flutter mobile app. The provider requires a system browser or authentication session and forbids embedded WebViews.

name: swagger-ui-inventory-and-scoped-flutter-client
prompt: Read the complete OpenAPI contract behind this Swagger UI without executing its remote JavaScript, report every operation and schema, then generate only the Customer tag using the Flutter app's existing Dio and serialization setup.

name: ordinary-dio-retry-is-not-openapi-generation
prompt: The existing Dio client already has typed request and response models. Fix cancellation and bounded retry behavior for one idempotent GET endpoint; no Swagger or OpenAPI contract is being read or changed.

name: reusable-openapi-dart-sdk
prompt: Generate and maintain a publicly distributed Dart SDK from this versioned OpenAPI contract, preserve consumer compatibility, add an example, and prepare a pub.dev dry run without publishing it.

name: flavor-build-configuration-vs-ci-pipeline
prompt: Configure Android productFlavors and iOS build configurations for a new staging environment in our Flutter project files, including separate bundle IDs and dart-define values. No CI workflow files or remote pipeline runners are being configured.

name: os-periodic-sync-vs-local-reminder
prompt: Schedule an hourly background catalog synchronisation job that runs even when the app is terminated using WorkManager and BGTaskScheduler. Do not post any user-visible notifications or alerts.

name: screen-reader-semantics-audit-vs-visual-redesign
prompt: Audit and fix the accessibility tree for a custom checkout button and order card so TalkBack and VoiceOver announce state and actions clearly. Do not change the visual styling, theme, colors, or art direction.

name: vietnamese-layout-overflow
prompt: Màn hình đặt hàng bị lỗi RenderFlex overflowed khi người dùng bật cỡ chữ lớn (text scale 200%) trên điện thoại hẹp. Hãy sửa bố cục co giãn hợp lý và kiểm tra khả năng tiếp cận.

name: vietnamese-parse-json-isolate
prompt: Ứng dụng bị giật khung hình (jank) khi parse mảng JSON dữ liệu lớn 5MB trả về từ API. Hãy chuyển việc giải mã JSON nặng sang Isolate hoặc compute để giải phóng main thread.

name: vietnamese-deep-link-navigation
prompt: Cấu hình deep link điều hướng người dùng trực tiếp vào màn hình chi tiết sản phẩm và kiểm tra khởi chạy link thực tế trên máy ảo Android.

name: vietnamese-secure-storage
prompt: Lưu trữ access token và refresh token một cách an toàn bằng Keychain trên iOS và EncryptedSharedPreferences trên Android thay vì lưu plain text trong SharedPreferences.

name: vietnamese-form-validation
prompt: Xây dựng form đăng ký tài khoản có xác thực email, mật khẩu mạnh và số điện thoại Việt Nam với thông báo lỗi rõ ràng khi submit.

name: vietnamese-text-orphan-and-overflow
prompt: Text trên màn hình bị lỗi rớt dòng dư một từ đơn lẻ nhìn rất xấu (orphaned word), và trong một số Row thì text dài quá bị lỗi RenderFlex overflowed. Cần giải pháp xử lý hiển thị text đúng cách bằng non-breaking space và Expanded.

name: orphaned-words-and-text-wrapping
prompt: Headings on our product page are wrapping with single words dangling on the next line (widows/orphans), and card descriptions are clipping without ellipsis. Help me format and wrap Flutter text properly.

name: inline-rich-text-spans-and-overflow
prompt: We need to render a paragraph with bold terms, inline tag badges, and ellipsis truncation at 3 lines, plus measure its rendered size with TextPainter.

name: frozen-ui-after-tap-is-not-jank

name: production-cold-start-signals-not-local-profiling

name: figma-node-with-frosted-glass-card

name: backdrop-blur-on-existing-card-without-redesign
prompt: Add a frosted backdrop blur behind our existing Flutter bottom sheet header, with a reduced-transparency fallback. Keep the current colors, typography, spacing, and layout unchanged; there is no Figma source.
